pages.purpose: Open on lanterns torn from trailposts
pages.beat: Stage the thunderclap tearing four lanterns from their posts and sending them downhill.
requiredContinuity: Four lanterns are loose and downhill.
Rabbit and Wise Turtle remain at the trailhead.
pages.endingPressure: The neighbors still need a safe route before moonrise.

pages.purpose: Set the deadline and blocked picnic
pages.beat: Set neighbors waiting at the trailhead and moonrise as deadline; the dark route blocks their picnic.
requiredContinuity: Neighbors wait at the trailhead.
The picnic must happen before moonrise.
pages.endingPressure: The unmarked trail is now the urgent problem.

pages.beat: Rabbit dashes down the path alone while Wise Turtle begins checking posts in order behind him.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit searches ahead alone.
Wise Turtle follows, checking posts in order.
pages.endingPressure: Rabbit is already beyond Turtle's careful first check.

pages.beat: Rabbit races past post one without reading its mark, searching for the nearest fallen light.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit has not checked post one's symbol.
pages.endingPressure: A missing mark leaves Rabbit guessing where to search.

pages.beat: Rabbit finds Leaf beneath a fern east of post one and grabs it without checking its symbol.
requiredContinuity: Leaf was observed beneath the fern east of post one.
Rabbit carries Leaf.
pages.endingPressure: Leaf's safe post remains empty while Rabbit carries it.

pages.purpose: Misplace Leaf and confuse the path
pages.beat: He fastens Leaf at post two, where its mismatched glow makes the route harder to read.
requiredContinuity: Leaf is incorrectly fastened at post two.
Rabbit sees the trail is more confusing.
pages.endingPressure: The misplaced glow now points travelers the wrong way.

pages.beat: Wise Turtle checks all four posts in order, finding Leaf misplaced at post two.
requiredContinuity: Turtle discovers Leaf at post two.
Turtle continues the search without guessing.
pages.endingPressure: The scattered lights still conceal where others landed.

pages.beat: Continuing the checks, he spots Moon in a willow farther east and downhill than Leaf's fern landing.
requiredContinuity: Moon is observed in a willow farther east and downhill.
Turtle has observed both landing places.
pages.endingPressure: The willow clue has no meaning until compared.

pages.purpose: Compare landings and predict the route
pages.beat: Rabbit rejoins; compare fern east of post one with farther/downhill willow; east/downhill gust predicts reeds, then stream bend.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit rejoins Turtle.
They infer the gust carried lanterns east and downhill.
pages.endingPressure: Their prediction now commits them to a specific route.

pages.beat: Rabbit returns Leaf from post two to its marked post one, clearing the mismatch.
requiredContinuity: Leaf is back at matching post one.
Post two is clear.
pages.endingPressure: Moon remains missing farther along the inferred wind line.

pages.beat: At the willow, Turtle frees Moon and passes it to Rabbit, who carries it to post two.
requiredContinuity: Moon is fastened at matching post two.
Leaf remains at post one.
pages.endingPressure: Two lanterns are restored; two landing places remain unknown.

pages.beat: Turtle chooses to test Rabbit's evidence and follows his predicted route east and downhill toward reeds.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit and Turtle head toward the reeds.
They expect reeds before the stream bend.
pages.endingPressure: The reeds must test their forecast next.

pages.purpose: Ask for help at the reeds
pages.beat: At the reeds, Rabbit asks Turtle to hold stalks apart before reaching for Star.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit asks Turtle for help.
Star remains tangled in the reeds.
pages.endingPressure: Star is trapped among reeds despite a sound plan.

pages.purpose: Free Star and restore its post
pages.beat: Turtle holds the reeds while Rabbit frees Star, then Rabbit carries it to matching post three.
requiredContinuity: Star is fastened at matching post three.
Turtle and Rabbit remain together on the route.
pages.endingPressure: Acorn still waits at the stream bend.

pages.purpose: Choose a steady route to the bend
pages.beat: Instead of rushing over slick roots, Rabbit waits beside Turtle; together they reach the stream bend.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit waits for Turtle over slick roots.
They arrive together at the stream bend.
pages.endingPressure: A slick approach tests Rabbit's new restraint.

pages.beat: They discover Acorn lodged in soft mud beside the bank, still glowing but unreachable.
requiredContinuity: Acorn is stuck in mud by the stream bend.
Acorn remains undamaged.
pages.endingPressure: Acorn cannot reach its post while mud holds fast.

pages.beat: Rabbit loosens the mud carefully and passes Acorn to Turtle, who steadies it safely.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit passes Acorn to Turtle.
Turtle carries Acorn safely.
pages.endingPressure: Acorn is safe, but the matching post remains ahead.

pages.beat: Turtle carries Acorn to post four; Rabbit checks its symbol before they set it in place.
requiredContinuity: Acorn is fastened at matching post four.
Rabbit verifies the symbol.
pages.endingPressure: With four lamps restored, the path can be tested.

pages.beat: Acorn matches post four; all four lanterns now glow on their matching posts.
requiredContinuity: All four lanterns are on matching posts.
All four lanterns glow.
pages.endingPressure: The neighbors still need guiding along the lit route.

pages.beat: Rabbit leads one quick check, confirming every turn is visible; Wise Turtle follows without recounting.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit completes one quick path check.
Turtle trusts Rabbit's check.
pages.endingPressure: A quick check must be enough to trust.

pages.beat: Trusting Rabbit's check, Wise Turtle turns back with him toward the trailhead to fetch neighbors.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit and Turtle head back to the trailhead.
They do not recount the lanterns.
pages.endingPressure: Neighbors remain at the trailhead until the pair returns.

pages.beat: They return to the trailhead, where Rabbit admits his wrong-post fix to waiting neighbors.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit admits he misplaced Leaf.
Neighbors are still waiting at the trailhead.
pages.endingPressure: The waiting group needs Rabbit's honest explanation.

pages.beat: Rabbit explains the lit route and invites everyone to follow at a comfortable pace.
requiredContinuity: Neighbors know the route is lit.
The neighbors agree to follow.
pages.endingPressure: The neighbors must choose whether to follow.

pages.purpose: Start the group along the path
pages.beat: The neighbors agree; Rabbit starts them along the path, and Turtle leaves without a second count.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit leads the neighbors from the trailhead.
Turtle skips a second count.
pages.endingPressure: The group enters the path before moonrise.

pages.purpose: Keep the group together at the bend
pages.beat: At the first bend, Rabbit waits until the last neighbor catches up before leading onward.
requiredContinuity: The group reaches the first bend together.
Rabbit waits for the last neighbor.
pages.endingPressure: The last neighbors must catch up at the bend.

pages.purpose: Guide neighbors around the next curve
pages.beat: At the next curve, Rabbit points out the lantern ahead and keeps the group together.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit leads at the group's pace.
The neighbors remain together.
pages.endingPressure: The group rounds the next curve together.

pages.purpose: Trust Rabbit through the final stretch
pages.beat: Wise Turtle follows Rabbit's route without stopping to recount, and the clearing appears beyond the trees.
requiredContinuity: Turtle follows Rabbit without recounting.
The clearing is now visible.
pages.endingPressure: The clearing is close, but moonrise approaches.

pages.beat: Everyone reaches the clearing before moonrise, guided by the four lanterns Rabbit restored.
requiredContinuity: All neighbors reach the clearing before moonrise.
The four lanterns remain on their posts.
pages.endingPressure: The group reaches shelter before the deadline.

pages.purpose: Begin the picnic beneath steady lights
pages.beat: Beneath four steady lights, neighbors unpack the picnic while Rabbit and Turtle share the first quiet moment.
requiredContinuity: The picnic has begun in the clearing.
Rabbit and Turtle stay together.
pages.endingPressure: The urgent search gives way to shared celebration.

pages.beat: Rabbit settles beside Turtle, listening to crickets instead of racing ahead; Turtle enjoys the evening without checking.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit chooses to stay and listen.
Turtle rests without checking the lanterns.
pages.endingPressure: The night ends in trust and unhurried company.
